C1.worst_defect: The hero "Point of sale for Vendure" with the real till screenshot and "Live demo" button lands at once, but nothing above the fold tells an owner it suits a counter with staff and a card terminal; that only comes later ("Card payments are taken on a separate terminal" is on Limitations).

C2.worst_defect: The honest "Live demo or your own store" table says the till sends "anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com", a domain from another brand that is never explained, so an owner wonders who gets their shop's data.

C3.worst_defect: The path to a working till is a developer's 9-step quick start (plugin install, migration, RXDB_PREMIUM token) and Limitations only says "Its browser tests run in desktop Chrome; other browsers are not tested yet", so an owner gets no word on which tablet or computer to put on the counter for staff tomorrow.

C4.worst_defect: "Refund a sale" says "On plugin 0.3.0 the till cannot refund ... Vendure keeps the refund Pending until an administrator settles it with the Admin API's settleRefund mutation": a GraphQL mutation means nothing to an owner, and the page never says in plain words "ask your developer to do this". Troubleshooting's "Resolve a sale the store kept part-way" is GraphQL-only in the same way.

C5.worst_defect: On docs pages the sidebar's grey background stops about 900 px down and leaves a lighter strip below it on every desktop slice; dark mode holds up well otherwise.

C6.worst_defect: The footer links "GitHub npm Limitations Changelog" are small text with tight tap targets, and the cashier-sheet image on the phone has a grey stripe down its left edge and different contents ("open since" time, "Sync now") from the desktop copy.

C7.worst_defect: Nothing that matters to an owner: every page returns 200 with titles, descriptions and JSON-LD, and Lighthouse mobile is 98/100/100/100. The og-image crops the till screenshot partway through the cart, and the phone LCP is 2.3-2.4 s.

overall_worst.defect: On a real store the till cannot refund: "Vendure keeps the refund Pending until an administrator settles it with the Admin API's settleRefund mutation". This is in developer terms with no plain step for the owner, and the live demo refunds at the till, so the demo hides the gap.
overall_worst.fix: Start "Refund a sale" with one plain line: "On your own store, cashiers can't refund yet. Your developer or store admin refunds the order in the Vendure Dashboard and settles it (see Plugin setup > Settle a Dashboard refund)." Say the same in the home table's refund row.
